decision: Use the durably reserved warm H200 for one exact-consumer component ledger of the source-complete QKV norm+RoPE to E5M2 NHD KV-cache epilogue.
causal_hypothesis: Committing E5M2 K/V cache bytes from the live QKV norm+RoPE producer removes the downstream clone, divide, cast, and store path without adding CTAs; every exact local/global geometry should preserve QKV and cache semantics and have lower median component time.
stock_control: For each exact row and attention class, qkv_norm_rope_inplace followed by the pinned MHATokenToKVPool E5M2 NHD set_kv_buffer path in the same fresh process.
candidate: For each identical input, qkv_norm_rope_cache_store commits the E5M2 NHD cache directly from the producer CTAs with no new CTA or intermediate tensor.

quality_and_performance_contract.performance_gate: Every one of the ten exact cases must have positive candidate median reduction. Persist distributions and the unnormalized per-call delta; do not infer an endpoint result.

required_behavior: Hash-bind this director binding, the final owner source, and every bound input in the derived execution binding before claim.
Use the shared gpu_pool CLI for one atomic exact-bench claim with lease_seconds=1200, 30-second heartbeats, generation-fenced release, and current bench-derived SSH identity.
Stage only the five small bound project files to /home/glmrunner/fixed-floor-crossop-executor using temporary names, SHA-256 verification, and atomic rename.
Use sudo -n docker from the first Nebius Docker command and the pinned image digest.

Mount the staged directory at the exact project absolute path expected by exact_consumer.py, run the bound command once, and retrieve the invocation state, terminal, stdout, stderr, and compact GPU identity.
A recoverable pre-science path, import, permission, container, or runtime API defect must retain the claim through a fresh repair-handshake generation while the corrected run and release still fit.
Release only after a complete positive or negative ten-case terminal, unsafe or unreachable guest, or the absolute claim deadline.

artifact_contract: Derived execution binding, final owner hash, exact claim generation, controller PID/start ticks, and phase timestamps.
GPU identity, installed memory_pool identity, staged-file manifest, invocation state, raw stdout/stderr, and every ten-case terminal row.
Per-case stock/candidate distributions, QKV error, bytewise cache equality, consumed checksum, and candidate-path identity.
Useful GPU seconds, complete claim exposure, typed terminal, and generation-fenced release evidence.
must: Prepare and hash-bind the narrow owner before claim, then re-read this exact bench once and claim by 04:08Z.
Publish STATUS.json.active_session only after the detached owner is proven live, heartbeating, and beyond claim or first execution-equivalent boundary; return immediately after one grouped snapshot.
If owner preparation cannot finish before the claim fence, leave the bench unclaimed and persist the exact blocker for the director.
must_not: Do not run an endpoint, DFlash, NGRAM, another kernel decomposition, or another scientific submission.
Do not mutate the checkpoint, provider resources, watchdog, runtime image, model geometry, scales, oracle, or timing contract.
Do not claim another bench or call provider lifecycle.
Do not release for an ordinary recoverable pre-science defect while a corrected execution plus terminal and release still fit; do not retain the claim after the absolute release deadline.
